architecture.summary: Probe tooling only: script/spike/gateway-proxy-probe.ts gains a --protocol 2025-11-25 run that pins the client of the SO-01d local gateway model to protocol 2025-11-25 and checks a cancellation by notifications/cancelled through the proxy, with a 2026-07-28 client as the contrast; the new modules script/spike/gateway-proxy/cancel-notification.ts, cancel-measure.ts, and wire-tap.ts hold the steps, the measure of one aborted call, and a recording fetch for the client; the proxy also records when it ends an answer, and the default 2026-07-28 run and its output stay the same apart from the times. The Slice 1 evidence record docs/implementation/self-onboarding-s1.md gains the subsection Cancellation by notifications/cancelled (2025-era clients) in the SO-01d section, with the measured times, a mutation check, the findings, and a design note for Slice 2, and the SO-05 gateway ticket of docs/implementation/self-onboarding-plan.md refers to it. No source, runtime, registry view, declaration, or deployment change.
